AfyaHASET is a digital health app designed to make healthcare simple and accessible.

The app connects patients with qualified doctors for easy appointment booking, helps users find medicines in nearby pharmacies, and promotes health awareness through educational content and preventive care information.
Our goal is to improve healthcare access through technology and support healthier communities.

The information and services provided through AfyaHASET are intended for health management and educational purposes only. They do not substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health providers with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition. Do not disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you have read on this app.

Sera ya Ada kwa Kila Huduma

Ada kwa kila huduma ni kiasi kisichobadilika kinachotozwa kwa kila ushauri au huduma inayofanyika. Ada hii inalipia utaalamu wa daktari, matumizi ya vifaa vya kituo, na gharama za usimamizi. 

Mambo Muhimu:
1. Ada hairudishwi baada ya huduma kutolewa.
2. Huduma za dharura zinaweza kuwa na gharama za ziada.
3. Kughairi chini ya saa 2 kabla ya miadi kunaweza kusababisha kutozwa sehemu ya ada.
4. Malipo huchakatwa kwa usalama kupitia app ya H-Care.
Sera ya Ufuatiliaji na Ruhusa ya Eneo

Ili kukuunganisha na wagonjwa walio karibu na kuthibitisha anwani ya kliniki yako, H-Care inahitaji ruhusa ya eneo lako.

Mambo Muhimu:
1. Eneo lako sahihi hutumika tu unapoongeza au kusasisha anwani ya kliniki yako.
2. Hatufuatilii eneo lako muda wote kwa nyuma.
3. Eneo la kliniki yako huonyeshwa kwa wagonjwa ili kuwasaidia kufika na kuweka miadi.
4. Unaweza kuondoa ruhusa ya eneo wakati wowote kupitia mipangilio ya kifaa chako, ingawa hii inaweza kupunguza uwezo wako wa kusasisha anwani ya kliniki.
Chagua akaunti itakayopokea malipo yako. Idhini ya fedha inahitajika kabla ya kuitumia.
